run_validation_ml_neb: run a validation of the ML NEB model on a set of NEB calculations using argparse CLI arguments
run_get_results_ml: run the get_results_ml function to compute percent success and convergence for ML-only NEB results
run_get_results_sp: run the get_results_sp function to compute percent success and convergence for single point NEB results
run_parse_neb_info: run the parse_neb_info function to process ML NEB results and extract barrier height and reaction energy
run_all_converged: run the all_converged function to assess whether a NEB calculation row is converged across ML and DFT
